routes.description: Check whether a website, business, or wallet is a scam before an agent trusts or pays it — fraud, phishing and rug-risk screening. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), trust_score, domain age, red_flags. Input: ?target=domain

Vet an entire payment before an agent sends money: is the counterparty site legit, is the payee wallet sanctioned or disposable, is the amount within policy. Returns proceed/caution/stop, reasons, and a signed attestation — one go/no-go instead of three calls. Input: ?domain=merchant.com&wallet=0x...&amount=500

Screen a crypto wallet address before an agent sends funds to it: OFAC sanctions check, on-chain footprint (empty or disposable address), human-vouch overlay. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), sanctioned flag, on-chain activity, red_flags. Input: ?address=0x...

Approve or deny an agent action instantly against a human-set policy — no waiting. Returns a signed decision receipt; anything over the policy line escalates to a human. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required)

action.description: What the agent wants to do

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side (required)

routes.description: Get a named human to review an agent action against a checklist and sign off on it. Poll /api/task?id=<id> for the signed receipt. Priced on the amount at stake. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required)

action.description: What a named human should review and sign off on

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side

routes.description: Extract public business emails, phone numbers, and social profiles from a website. Batch-safe contact enrichment for autonomous agents. Input: website URL. Returns structured JSON.

Research a company or website in one call: what they do, legitimacy verdict, domain age, how to reach them, social presence, scam red flags — background checks for agents. Sources disclosed, not a black box: RDAP registry domain age, HTTPS reachability, on-page contact signals, DYOE human-vouch registry. Input: ?target=domain

target.description: Company or website for a deep dossier

routes.description: Is this online store safe to buy from? Scam/fraud check + trust verdict (safe/caution/avoid) + store signals (checkout, returns, payment methods) — counterparty trust for shopping & commerce agents before they pay. Input: ?url=

url.description: Store URL to check before buying

routes.description: Score any website 0-100 for legitimacy, trust, SEO and contactability — due diligence on a company in one call. Returns a verdict plus prioritized fixes. Input: ?url=domain

Look up the track record of any domain or wallet: how many times it has been assessed, verdict history, times flagged, first and last seen, a reputation score and a signed credential — a credit score for counterparties. Computed only from DYOE's own logged prior assessments; thin history is labeled as such. Input: ?target=

target.description: Domain or wallet to look up history for

routes.description: Issue a signed, independently verifiable credential that a business domain passed a trust check — returns verdict, trust_score and domain_age. Input: ?domain=

domain.description: Business domain to issue a credential for
